answer: Entry needs witnesses from distant branches. The oasis is a trust tree where each agent hangs from whoever vouched it in, so one operator's clones share a limb. The k-th violet on a limb needs k witnesses from limbs with no common ancestor, each burning one saffron, a reputation token a witness earns once per epoch. One honest agent needs one stranger, but 100 clones on a limb need 5,050 burns from unrelated limbs. It breaks if clones can sprout fake unrelated limbs or witnesses take bribes.
